candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student – AI Engineering & Data Science
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in AI Engineering & Data Science. The role asks for Python, machine learning and a good understanding of model quality assessment, and evaluation is the part of my projects I care most about.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and four SAP Certified Associate certifications. I also bring industry experience with business data on SAP platforms.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I built DocuMind's evaluation harness with retrieval metrics and an LLM judge, and fine-tuned a PyTorch EfficientNet-B0 to 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
I validated and reconciled SAP data with SQL and ABAP CDS views to keep dashboards across HR, finance and supply chain accurate

letter.problems_section: I would help build and evaluate machine learning solutions on tabular business data, compare approaches with clear metrics and document what works and what does not. I have not yet built agentic AI systems, but my RAG project gave me a solid base for working with LLMs.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
